items.title: A Decal and Discounts on American Ships for the US Navy’s Birthday!
items.summary: The U.S. Navy’s birthday marks the anniversary of the Continental Congress’s decision to establish a naval force, adopted on October 13th, 1775. On this day, American sailors cut the cake in a special way…

items.title: Spooky Monthly Decals for October!
items.summary: Hey everyone! As it’s October, we thought we’d change the format up a bit and go with a set of decals that fit the Halloween month. We’ve got skulls, ghosts and a black cat too of course! For the “Red Devils”…
